title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated MagAttract v.2
author: Graeme Oatley

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix with the following volumes per sample:

substeps.instruction: 200 µL Phosphate buffered solution (PBS)
20 µL Proteinase K
4 µL RNase A
150 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Sample Homogenisation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Process samples based on their preparation method to initiate lysis.

substeps.instruction: For cryogenically homogenised samples: Transfer 25 mg of sample into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and hold on dry ice. Add 374 µL of lysis buffer master mix and homogenise by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.

For PowerMashed samples (< 25 mg): Transfer sample into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube and add 374 µL lysis buffer. Disrupt using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain. Transfer entire contents to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore tip.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge sample tubes briefly and incubate on the heat block at 25 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: While samples are lysing, label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required wells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip plate: 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Elution 2: 200 µL Buffer AE
Elution 1: 200 µL Buffer AE
NFW: 200 µL Nuclease-Free Water
Wash PE: 500 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer PE
MW1 Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer MW1
MW1 Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer MW1
Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Once lysis is complete, remove tubes from the heat block and centrifuge briefly to spin down. Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate from sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding large pieces of debris.

steps.title: Run DNA Extraction Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the DNA extraction on the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol from the protocol list and press the play button.
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Remove the 'Tip Plate' when prompted before loading the 'Sample Plate'.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 50 minutes) and remove plates following on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Inspect and Clean Eluates
steps.instruction: Check elution plates for remaining magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: If beads are present in the eluate, transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a magnetic rack for approximately 5 minutes.
Collect the clear DNA eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Combine Elutions
steps.instruction: Using a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide-bore tips, pipette eluates from Elution Plate 2 into Elution Plate 1. Gently pipette mix 5–10 times with wide-bore tips to homogenise DNA. Elution Plate 1 is now the 'Sample Plate' for the 0.45X SPRI.

steps.title: Prepare 0.45X SPRI Plates
steps.instruction: Set up the KingFisher™ plates for the 0.45X SPRI as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip Plate (1 mL Deep-well): 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Sample Plate (Elution Plate 1): 380 µL DNA + 171 µL AMPure PB beads
Ethanol Wash Plate (1 mL Deep-well): 1000 µL 80% EtOH (freshly made)
Elution Plate (200 µL standard): 135 µL Buffer EB

steps.title: Run 0.45X SPRI Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the 0.45X SPRI on the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the required 0.45X SPRI protocol from the list and press the play button.
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 40 minutes) and remove plates following on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the final DNA and store.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight.
Perform QC the following morning.
Store DNA at 4 °C.
